comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
After gaining some merits on Rank 1 of Commercial Battle License, you can obtain this by giving away 100 Merits to get one. According to JP wiki, here's the list of Reward (you get one of these randomly) :

Navy Dispatch Request
2x Patriot Award
3x Renegotiation Demand
Stomach Medicine
Headache Medication
3x Purchase Order Collection

While some from the lists are confirmed obtainable in Maris, the others could be removed/swapped to something else. But yes still need confirmation and need to be checked later
